concepts.title: Reference combination
concepts.instruction: Draw the Ø50 × 70 mm cylinder and the central Ø30 mm sphere tangent to its top in elevation.

concepts.title: Reduced scale
concepts.instruction: Construct the scale and obtain iso 50, iso 70 and iso 15.

concepts.title: Cylinder base
concepts.instruction: Construct the reduced base rhombus and its oval using iso 50.

concepts.title: Cylinder top
concepts.instruction: Erect iso 70, construct the matching top oval and join the visible tangent generators.

concepts.title: Sphere centre
concepts.instruction: Locate contact point P at the top centre and raise O vertically by iso 15.

concepts.title: Sphere silhouette
concepts.instruction: Draw a true R15 circle about O; the sphere silhouette radius is not reduced.

concepts.title: Finish
concepts.instruction: Add the O/P labels, reduced cylinder dimensions and true sphere-radius annotation.

notes: The silhouette circle overlaps the top oval in projection. The contact point is below O by iso 15, not by the visible circle radius; apparent circle/oval tangency is not the constraint.
